agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the resignation of Mr. Arief Santosa from his position as Independent Commissioner effective as of the meeting's close. The company expressed appreciation for his contributions and dedication during his tenure.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the honorable dismissal of all current members of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners and appointed new members for a five-year term ending in 2031. The new composition includes Putra Harianto Batee as President Director and Suriyanto as President Commissioner, alongside two directors and two other commissioners.

Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the annual report and audited financial statements for fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, and granted full release and discharge to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners. The vote passed with 78.758% approval, with no dissents or abstentions, based on an unqualified opinion from KAP Doli, Bambang, Sulistiyanto, Dadang & Ali dated March 31, 2026.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved delegating authority to the Board of Commissioners to determine salaries and benefits for Directors, and confirmed Commissioner remuneration remains at the same level as 2025 with possible adjustments. The vote passed with 78.758% approval, with no dissents or abstentions, at the meeting held on June 24, 2026.
Agenda #3: Shareholders approved delegating authority to the Board of Commissioners to appoint a public accounting firm registered with OJK for the 2026 fiscal year audit, and authorized the Board of Directors to set the honorarium and terms. The vote passed with 78.758% approval, with no dissents or abstentions.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved the resignation of Commissioner Sugito Walujo and Director Dennis Rahardja, and appointed new members to both boards, resulting in a new composition effective from the close of the meeting until the 2031 AGM. The vote passed with 78.758% approval, with no dissents or abstentions; the new term runs from June 24, 2026 to June 24, 2031.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved changing the company name to PT NexAI Digital Infrastruktur Tbk (or another name approved by authorities) and changing the company logo, requiring an amendment to Article 1 paragraph (1) of the Articles of Association. The vote passed with 78.758% approval, with no dissents or abstentions, and the company sent announcement number 10/PAW/MGLV/VI/2026.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Persetujuan perubahan Pasal 3 ayat (1) dan (2) anggaran dasar Perseroan mengenai maksud dan tujuan serta kegiatan usaha. Rapat menyetujui perubahan Pasal 3 anggaran dasar terkait perubahan kegiatan usaha, termasuk menerima hasil studi kelayakan dari FDI Partners. Keputusan diambil melalui pemungutan suara dengan hasil setuju 335.847.100 saham (90,2573%), abstain 2.800 saham, dan tidak ada suara tidak setuju.
Agenda #2: Approval of the company's plan to conduct a rights issue (PMHMETD) and increase issued and paid-up capital. The meeting approved the rights issue of up to 285,732,512 new shares at Rp20 par value, with voting results: 335,844,600 shares in favor, 2,800 abstain, 2,500 against. Delegation of authority to the Board of Directors for implementation was also granted.
Agenda #3: Approval of amendment to Article 4 paragraph (2) of the articles of association. The meeting approves changing the company's articles of association regarding increased issued and paid-up capital in the context of PMHMETD, to be done after PMHMETD completion, including restating the articles.
Agenda #4: Approval of transactions and actions related to PMHMETD. The resolution approves actions including notarial deeds, obtaining approvals, signing documents, and other necessary actions, as well as approving transactions disclosed in the company's information disclosure.
Agenda #5: Granting authority to the Board of Commissioners for PMHMETD implementation. The meeting approves giving full power to the Board of Commissioners to determine and realize the number of new shares, exercise price, record date, ratio, and schedule of PMHMETD as proposed by the Board of Directors, subject to regulations.
Agenda #6: Approval of listing all new shares on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The meeting approves the listing of all new shares on the Indonesia Stock Exchange in accordance with applicable regulations.
Agenda #7: Ratification of actions taken by the Board of Commissioners and/or Directors in relation to PMHMETD. The meeting ratifies and approves actions already or to be taken by the Board of Commissioners and/or Directors in the context of PMHMETD, including making and delivering information disclosure, prospectus, and PMHMETD information.
Agenda #8: Granting power of attorney to Directors and Corporate Secretary for PMHMETD execution. The meeting approves granting power with substitution rights to each member of the Board of Directors individually or jointly and/or the Corporate Secretary to carry out all necessary actions related to PMHMETD, including appointing standby buyers, appointing capital market supporting institutions, signing registration statements, negotiating agreements, determining exercise price, record date, schedule, use of proceeds, share custody, listing shares, and other actions.
Agenda #9: Approval of plan to sell subsidiaries and transfer assets/liabilities to third parties (material transaction per POJK 17/2020). Shareholders approved the sale of shares in subsidiary companies and the transfer of assets and liabilities to third parties, and granted authority to Directors to execute the transaction. Voting: 335,847,100 shares in favor (90.2573%), 2,800 abstain, no votes against.
Agenda #10: Approval of changes to the company's management structure. Shareholders approved the appointment of Widjono Hardjanto as Independent Commissioner effective from the close of this meeting until the close of the Annual GMS in 2031, and confirmed the full board composition. Voting: 1,868,577,900 shares in favor (90.9999%), 2,800 abstain, no votes against.
Agenda #11: Approval of acquisition of NAC and NGC shares and NDC receivables. Shareholders approved the plan for the company to take over shares of NAC and NGC from NDC and NDC's receivables against NAC and NGC, classified as material and affiliated transactions under POJK 17/2020 and POJK 42/2020. Voting results: 335,847,100 shares in favor, 2,800 abstentions, no dissenting votes. Authority granted to the Board of Directors to execute the transaction.
Agenda #12: Approval of shareholder loan from NDC. Shareholders approved the acceptance of a shareholder loan from NDC, also classified as a material and affiliated transaction under POJK 17/2020 and POJK 42/2020. Voting results: 335,847,100 shares in favor, 2,800 abstentions, no dissenting votes. Authority granted to the Board of Directors to execute the transaction.
